explanation.headline: Dulaglutide is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; the prior shortage posted 2022-12-15 is resolved

sentences.text: FDA's records show dulaglutide is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21, and the earlier shortage first posted on 2022-12-15 has been resolved.
No public FDA signal has been issued for our plants.
Corvale East holds 151 syringes of the 0.75 mg/0.5 mL presentation with a daily use of 3.4, providing 44.2 days on hand.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Eli Lilly and Company, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and operates the plant ELI LILLY AND CO.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
